name: zdeclient_crater_instance_event
description: zDEClient_Crater::InstanceEvent saves the vertex-merge epsilon, instances/builds/creates crater geometry, appends and submits the feature, applies node/DI pairs, restores epsilon, and optionally starts the crater effect animation.
known_limits: The smoke target covers successful InitFeatureFromEventTemplate followed by Build failure, including DestroyFeature cleanup and vertex-merge epsilon restoration; full success-side geometry submission and optional effect animation are covered through accepted callees and deferred to the coherent zDEClient crater feature pass.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient crater/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x456b20 validates saving/restoring zModel_Const vertex merge epsilon, SetVertexMergeEpsilon(0.00499999989), InitFeatureFromEventTemplate failure report/restore, Build failure DestroyFeature/report/restore, CreateFeature failure DestroyFeature/report/restore, AppendFeatureEntry type 1, SubmitFeatureGeometry, ApplyNodeDiPairs, optional display-source effect animation transform call when requested and present, and 0/-1 returns.
The native crater InstanceEvent smoke verifies a successful crater feature initialization followed by Build failure returns -1 and restores the previous vertex-merge epsilon.
